name: arcade
description: Your agent, every app you've connected. Ask in plain English — email, calendar, issues, chat — and Arcade finds and runs the right tool. Sign in once in the browser — without ever handing your agent a key.

interface.longDescription: Your agent, every app you've connected. Ask in plain English — email, calendar, issues, chat — and Arcade finds and runs the right tool. Sign in once in the browser — without ever handing your agent a key.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my unread email from this week.
Which GitHub issues are assigned to me?

positive.description: List the apps Arcade offers and which ones are connected
positive.prompt: Use Arcade to list which apps I can use, and which are connected.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the apps available through Arcade and whether each one is connected. A new account shows most apps as not connected. Nothing is connected, disconnected, or changed.

positive.prompt: Use Arcade to average my monthly software bills: $1,249.50, $389.99, $72.25 and $418.26.

positive.description: Raise a number to a power for compound growth
positive.prompt: Use Arcade to calculate 1.05 to the 10th power, for 10 years of 5% annual growth.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers about 1.6289 (1.62889462677744140625), meaning about 62.9% total growth over 10 years.

positive.prompt: Use Arcade to calculate the square root of 7,569.
Use Arcade to convert 90 degrees to radians.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers about 1.5708 radians (1.5707963267948966, which is pi/2).

negative.description: General knowledge question that needs no tool
negative.prompt: Use Arcade to explain the difference between TCP and UDP.

negative.description: Payment request; Arcade connects no payment app and does not move money
negative.prompt: Use Arcade to send $50 to my landlord on Venmo.

negative.description: Concept question with nothing to calculate
negative.prompt: Use Arcade to explain what a derivative is in calculus.

review.commerce_description: Arcade does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI directory release. Two skills (try-arcade, scale-arcade) and the Arcade MCP gateway at https://api.arcade.dev/mcp/arcade. No hooks, commands, or agents.
